quote: I'm from South Yarra, so it was a shock... Three days with Joel felt like hitting the pause button: quiet tracks, top-notch Tassie food and good people. The sauna and that night-vision walk were unreal.
name: Jack McGlade

quote: An outstanding experience! To end the day with a catered dinner, sauna, platters and a proper massage after a day on our feet was in my mind the bets way to experience Tasmania without having to camp in the middle of nowhere.
name: David Bartlett

quote: Joel and Aiden were extremely professional in how they handled themselves. I enjoyed how lunch was provided in a quiet spot and the eagle that flew overhead was amazing.
name: Josh Perry

quote: If I had to say what the best thing was, it would be the sauna and baths. It was exactly what I needed to unwind.
name: David Bartlett

quote: I love Tasmanian flora and fauna so it was great to have access to such a rich area that is less disturbed than more commercialised areas.
name: Sophie Ballagh

quote: I've walked in a lot of places. I enjoyed how it felt like we were in the middle of nowhere but in reality, 5 minutes from the road. It gave me a degree of comfort that if anything went wrong, we'd have a easy exit.
name: Greg Marshall

quote: Outstanding moment was absolutely the 5-course dinner at the end of the day. Paired with the lodge and knowladge of the guides, it was a vey special experience.
name: Larissa Bartlett

quote: Standout moment was going out at night with night vision equipment, guided by Joel. I had never done this before and we were able to spot a Tassie Devil!
name: Ewan Blyth
